The intervention (high-pressure/high-temperature or sputter deposition to achieve a single phase) and the mechanism (lattice distortion strengthening and protective Al/Cr oxide formation) are taken almost verbatim from these passages, with only minor generalization to a broader class of alloys. The predicted outcome and test conditions are standard and do not combine findings from different papers in a new way.
